# Kyuri Park

Hi, I am a PhD candidate at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

My research interests are urban, macro, and labor economics.
Specifically, I study interactions between spatial heterogeneity and workers,
and their effects on economic outcomes, using quantitative spatial models.

Before joining the PhD program, I worked as an economist at the central
bank in Korea.

You can view my CV [here](CV_KP_2608.pdf).
:::
:::
